# The tenet-reform loop of the Sefer redesign (2026-11-08).

# Scope: a host. How pressing a question of belief on this tenet is:
# the rite expects a ruling on it after a Machloket (100), the host
# holds it (40), his books argue it (15). 0: not pressing.
kehillah_reform_pressing_score_tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { rite ?= { OR = { var:kehillah_reform_pending_tenet ?= 1 var:kehillah_reform_pending_tenet ?= 6 } } } add = 100 }
	if = { limit = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } add = 40 }
	if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } } add = 15 }
}
